exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: bedspread, bedcover (topmost covering of a bed)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: скрыть — to hide, to conceal; открыва́ться — to open; кры́шка — cover, lid; покрыва́ло — bedspread, bedcover (topmost covering of a bed).
**крышку** — кры́шка: cover, lid; (as a predicative, colloquial) death, ruin, end. Wiktionary: кры́ша + -ка.
